name: E-mail templates (base)
description: Renders every e-mail the platform sends: the template declared by the owning plugin (its manifest mailTemplates), customized per Dolt branch, wrapped in the global layout. Base of the notify.templates slot; the management screen ships in the mail-templates plugin.

mailTemplates.name: Global layout
mailTemplates.description: The shell every e-mail body is injected into: logo, brand color, page background, footer. Each template only edits its own body.
